decision.summary: A transient multi-axis perturbation centered at index 622–623 shows a sharp U-down/N-up signature. The U component drops ~6 MAD units over 3 samples and remains depressed through the end of the allowed context (index 660), with no observed return. Without recovery evidence, the interval is classified as uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed within [583,660].
